content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: Confidential Information means any and all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, including but not limited to trade secrets, know-how, customer lists, and technical data.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS_OF_THE_RECEPTING_PARTY
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party agrees to maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM_AND_TERMINATION
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect until terminated by either party upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other party.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 1st day of March 2024.
